social: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production animation sprite sheet for the AutoPets app, using the reference only for character identity. Cute cream 3D toy puppy, floppy tan ears, black oval eyes, tiny black nose, consistent studio light, no pixel art. Transparent alpha background. EXACT grid: FOUR columns by THREE rows, TWELVE evenly spaced square cells, no borders or labels. Each row is a four-frame animation sequence left to right. Puppy front-facing, identical scale and registration at same ground line in every cell, entire body/paws/ears/tail fit inside each cell with 10% margin. Row 1: sitting quietly, eyes open; half blink and tail left; eyes shut soft blink and tail right; eyes reopening neutral. Row 2: sitting, head looks toward viewer; paw lifts; paw waves with cheerful face; paw lowers to resting. Row 3: resting sitting pose; raises both forepaws in a gentle sleepy stretch, eyes soft closed; fully stretches upward ears droop; settles back down. NO laptop, no furniture, no symbols, no text, no glow, no solid background, no checkerboard. Preserve same puppy face and proportions across all frames. This is an actual sprite atlas for sequential frame playback; no scenes or camera movement.
notes: Use case: stylized-concept. AutoPets production sprite animation atlas. Character reference only: same cream soft 3D puppy, floppy tan ears, black oval eyes, black nose, plush clay-like body. The reference puppy identity must remain the same.
